text: Analyst estimates place the annual cost of Dodd-Frank Act registration and disclosure compliance for hedge fund advisers in a range from $50,000 to $400,000 per year.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Barbara Luppi, Sandra Paterlini, Did the Dodd-Frank Act Impact Hedge Fund Performance (2014). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2389416

isBasedOn.name: Did the Dodd-Frank Act Impact Hedge Fund Performance

abstract: Some analysts estimate that the cost will range from $50,000 to $400,000 per year (Kaal 2013a and 2013b).

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: estimates by analysts, not measured by the authors
